what: pytorch_model.bin of star23/baller8, a repository the Hub disabled after users reported a malicious payload in it.

evidence.basis: JFrog reports that users found a dangerously malicious payload in star23/baller8 and that the Hub blocked the model after their reports; JFrog does not show this file's payload. The repository is disabled and unchanged since 2023-12-13, before the report; this is the LFS object id the Hub API lists for its pytorch_model.bin, tied to the listed blob id by the pointer check.

source.title: Examining Malicious Hugging Face ML Models with Silent Backdoor
source.quote: Note that for another model of star23, users reported that the model contained a dangerously malicious payload, indicating that they were victims of this model. After receiving multiple reports, the Hugging Face platform blocked the model. / Community Reports issues in star23/baller8 model page
